{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgRacaZMMxMjnqJcyVeYj","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-AccountDelete.md ===\n# FEATURE: Account Delete\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account delete <code>`, which removes an account that has no transactions. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-AccountGet.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-ErrorContract.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger account delete |\n| Consumes | ledger.register_command, persistence.open_database, csv_output.write_rows, ledger_errors.NotFound, ledger_errors.Rejected, ledger txn post |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nDelete one account by code. An account that still has transactions is refused so that no transaction is orphaned. Source Rule 1 applies: the command checks everything before its single write.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Invocation: `ledger account delete <code>` with exactly one argument.\n- The account is looked up through `db.accounts.get`. An absent code exits 4 with nothing on stdout.\n- Transactions of the account are listed through `db.transactions.list(account=<code>)`. If any exist, the command exits 3 and changes nothing.\n- Otherwise the account is removed with `db.accounts.delete` and the command writes two CSV lines to stdout: `deleted`, then the code. No header row beyond that pair.\n- Failures write nothing to stdout and one diagnostic line to stderr.\n- The existence check, the transaction check and the delete run in one database transaction.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: look up the account - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — read: list the account's transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-005` — write: delete the account - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-delete-empty ===\nIntent: Deleting an account with no transactions prints deleted and the code, and the account is gone.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_ = \"ZQAD01\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code_, name=\"Empty Account\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", code_)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows == [[\"deleted\"], [code_]]\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code_) is None\n=== END AC account-delete-empty ===\n\n=== AC account-delete-in-use ===\nIntent: An account that has a transaction is refused with exit 3 and both records remain.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQAD02\"\ncat = \"ZQADC02\"\ntxn_id = 910002\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Busy Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Busy Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=1000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", acct)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=acct) is not None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is not None\n=== END AC account-delete-in-use ===\n\n=== AC account-delete-absent ===\nIntent: Deleting an absent account exits 4 with nothing on stdout and leaves other accounts alone.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nabsent = \"ZQAD03X\"\nother = \"ZQAD03\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=other, name=\"Bystander\")\n    before = len(db.accounts.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", absent)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.accounts.list()) == before\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=other) is not None\n=== END AC account-delete-absent ===\n\n=== AC account-delete-after-txn-removed ===\nIntent: Once its only transaction is removed, the account can be deleted.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQAD04\"\ncat = \"ZQADC04\"\ntxn_id = 910004\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Cleared Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Cleared Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=500, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", acct)\n    assert code == 3\n    db.transactions.delete(txn_id=txn_id)\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", acct)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=acct) is None\n=== END AC account-delete-after-txn-removed ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Never delete a transaction as a side effect of deleting an account.\n- A failing command writes nothing to stdout and never echoes a DSN or credential.\n- Database access goes only through the generated persistence package.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnPost.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Post\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn post`, which validates and stores one transaction with an assigned id under the non-negative balance rule. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-AccountAdd.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-ErrorContract.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn post |\n| Consumes | ledger.register_command, persistence.open_database, validation.parse_amount, validation.parse_date, validation.check_code, validation.check_text, balance_rules.check_final_balances, csv_output.write_rows, ledger_errors.Rejected |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRecord one receipt or payment against an account and category. Source Rules 1 to 7 apply: every input is checked before the first write, the balance never goes below zero, amounts are integer cents, dates are real calendar dates.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Invocation: `ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]`; four or five arguments.\n- Validation, all before any write, each failure exiting 3: account and category codes (1 to 12 of `A-Z0-9`); amount matching `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]` (no leading dot, `+`, spaces or separators, at most two decimals, never zero in any form) converted to integer cents with integer arithmetic; date a real `YYYY-MM-DD` date (`2028-02-29` valid, `2026-02-29` and `2026-02-30` invalid); memo 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline.\n- The account must exist (`db.accounts.get`) and the category must exist (`db.categories.get`); otherwise exit 3.\n- Balance: the resulting balance of the account (sum of its stored amounts plus the new amount) is checked with `balance_rules.check_final_balances`; a negative result exits 3.\n- The new `txn_id` is the largest stored id plus one, or 1 for an empty table, computed from `db.transactions.list`. The id computation, the balance check and the insert run in one database transaction so two concurrent posts never share an id.\n- A missing memo stores the empty string.\n- Success writes the header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and the new row, amount with exactly two decimals.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm the account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm the category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — read: list stored transactions for id and balance computation - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create the transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-post-success ===\nIntent: A valid post stores the row with the next id and prints it; the stored row reads back with integer cents.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQPOST1\"\ncat = \"ZQPOSTC1\"\namount = \"45.50\"\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    ids = [r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    expected_id = max(ids) + 1 if ids else 1\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount, date, memo)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 2\n    assert rows[1] == [str(expected_id), date, acct, cat, amount, memo]\n    back = db.transactions.get(txn_id=expected_id)\n    assert back is not None\n    assert back.amount == int(Decimal(amount) * 100)\n    assert isinstance(back.amount, int)\n    assert (back.date, back.account, back.category, back.memo) == (date, acct, cat, memo)\n=== END AC txn-post-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-no-memo ===\nIntent: A post without a memo stores an empty memo and prints an empty final field.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQPOST2\"\ncat = \"ZQPOSTC2\"\namount = \"10.00\"\ndate = \"2026-04-02\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount, date)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert len(rows[1]) == 6\n    assert rows[1][5] == \"\"\n    back = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(rows[1][0]))\n    assert back.memo == \"\"\n=== END AC txn-post-no-memo ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-consecutive-ids ===\nIntent: Two successive posts receive ids that differ by one.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQPOST3\"\ncat = \"ZQPOSTC3\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    got = []\n    for amount in (\"5.00\", \"6.00\"):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount, \"2026-04-03\")\n        print(out)\n        print(err)\n        assert code == 0\n        got.append(int(list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))[1][0]))\n    assert got[1] == got[0] + 1\n=== END AC txn-post-consecutive-ids ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-unknown-references ===\nIntent: An unknown account or unknown category exits 3 and stores nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQPOST4\"\ncat = \"ZQPOSTC4\"\nmissing = \"ZQNOSUCH4\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", missing, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, missing, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-post-unknown-references ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-bad-amounts ===\nIntent: Malformed, over-precise and zero amounts are rejected with exit 3 and store nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQPOST5\"\ncat = \"ZQPOSTC5\"\nbad = [\"1.234\", \".50\", \"+5.00\", \"0\", \"0.00\", \"-0\", \"1,000.00\", \" 5.00\", \"abc\", \"5.\", \"--5\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    for amount in bad:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount, \"2026-04-01\")\n        assert code == 3, amount\n        assert out == \"\", amount\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC txn-post-bad-amounts ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-dates ===\nIntent: Leap days are valid only in leap years and impossible dates are rejected.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQPOST6\"\ncat = \"ZQPOSTC6\"\ngood_leap = \"2028-02-29\"\nbad_dates = [\"2026-02-29\", \"2026-02-30\", \"2026-13-01\", \"2026-4-1\", \"not-a-date\"]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    for d in bad_dates:\n        before = len(db.transactions.list())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", d)\n        assert code == 3, d\n        assert out == \"\", d\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before, d\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", good_leap)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n=== END AC txn-post-dates ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-negative-balance ===\nIntent: A payment larger than the balance is rejected with exit 3, while one within the balance is accepted.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQPOST7\"\ncat = \"ZQPOSTC7\"\ndeposit = \"100.00\"\ntoo_much = \"-100.01\"\nfits = \"-40.00\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"-1.00\", \"2026-04-01\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == 0\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, deposit, \"2026-04-01\")\n    assert code == 0\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, too_much, \"2026-04-02\")\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list(account=acct)) == 1\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, fits, \"2026-04-02\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    balance = sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=acct))\n    assert balance == int(Decimal(deposit) * 100) + int(Decimal(fits) * 100)\n=== END AC txn-post-negative-balance ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-bad-text ===\nIntent: Invalid codes and memos are rejected with exit 3 and store nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQPOST8\"\ncat = \"ZQPOSTC8\"\nlong_memo = \"m\" * 61\nok_memo = \"m\" * 60\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    for args in (\n        (\"zqlower\", cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, \"bad code\", \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\"),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", long_memo),\n        (acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", \"has,comma\"),\n    ):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", *args)\n        assert code == 3, args\n        assert out == \"\", args\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, \"1.00\", \"2026-04-01\", ok_memo)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n=== END AC txn-post-bad-text ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No floating point is used for money at any layer; amounts are parsed and stored as integer cents.\n- A rejected post writes nothing; every check runs before the insert.\n- Do not read `sources/run.sh` or any seed file from application code.\n- A failing command writes nothing to stdout and never echoes a DSN or credential.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnGet.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Get\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description a single transaction by id from stored data.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Invocation: `ledger txn get <id>` with exactly one argument.\n- A non-integer id exits 3 (narrowest reading of the unspecified case, recorded as decision Q-003).\n- An integer id with no stored row exits 4 with nothing on stdout.\n- Otherwise the command writes the header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and the stored which removes an account that has no transactions. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-AccountGet.md, FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-ErrorContract.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger account delete |\n| Consumes | ledger.register_command, persistence.open_database, csv_output.write_rows, ledger_errors.NotFound, ledger_errors.Rejected, ledger txn post |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nDelete one account by code. An account that still has transactions is refused so that no transaction is orphaned. Source Rule 1 applies: the command checks everything before its single write.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Invocation: `ledger account delete <code>` with exactly one argument.\n- The account is looked up through `db.accounts.get`. An absent code exits 4 with nothing on stdout.\n- Transactions of the account are listed through `db.transactions.list(account=<code>)`. If any exist, the command exits 3 and changes nothing.\n- Otherwise the account is removed with `db.accounts.delete` and the command writes two CSV lines to stdout: `deleted`, then the code. No header row beyond that pair.\n- Failures write nothing to stdout and one diagnostic line to stderr.\n- The existence check, the transaction check and the delete run in one database transaction.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: look up the account - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — read: list the account's transactions - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-005` — write: delete the account - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-delete-empty ===\nIntent: Deleting an account with no transactions prints deleted and the code, and the account is gone.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode_ = \"ZQAD01\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=code_, name=\"Empty Account\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", code_)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows == [[\"deleted\"], [code_]]\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code_) is None\n=== END AC account-delete-empty ===\n\n=== AC account-delete-in-use ===\nIntent: An account that has a transaction is refused with exit 3 and both records remain.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQAD02\"\ncat = \"ZQADC02\"\ntxn_id = 910002\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Busy Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Busy Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=1000, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", acct)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=acct) is not None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is not None\n=== END AC account-delete-in-use ===\n\n=== AC account-delete-absent ===\nIntent: Deleting an absent account exits 4 with nothing on stdout and leaves other accounts alone.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nabsent = \"ZQAD03X\"\nother = \"ZQAD03\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=other, name=\"Bystander\")\n    before = len(db.accounts.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"delete\", absent)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 4\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.accounts.list()) == before\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=other) is not None\n=== END AC account-delete-absent ===\n\n=== AC account-delete-after-txn-removed ===\nIntent: Once its only transaction is removed, the account can be deleted.\n\nfrom cli.testing import Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Cleared Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=500, \"delete\", acct)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=acct) is None\n=== END AC account-delete-after-txn-removed ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- goes only through the generated persistence package.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnPost.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Post\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn post`, which validates and stores one transaction with an assigned id under the non-negative balance rule. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-AccountAdd.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-ErrorContract.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn post |\n| Consumes | ledger.register_command, persistence.open_database, validation.parse_amount, validation.parse_date, validation.check_code, validation.check_text, balance_rules.check_final_balances, csv_output.write_rows, ledger_errors.Rejected |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRecord one receipt or payment against an account and category. Source Rules 1 to 7 apply: every input is checked before the first write, the balance never goes below zero, amounts are integer cents, dates are real calendar dates.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Invocation: `ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]`; four or five arguments.\n- Validation, all before any write, each failure exiting 3: account and category codes (1 to 12 of `A-Z0-9`); amount matching `-?DIGITS[.D[D]]` (no leading dot, `+`, spaces or separators, at most two decimals, never zero in any form) converted to integer cents with integer arithmetic; date a real `YYYY-MM-DD` date (`2028-02-29` valid, `2026-02-29` and `2026-02-30` invalid); memo 0 to 60 characters with no comma or newline.\n- The account must exist (`db.accounts.get`) and the category must exist (`db.categories.get`); otherwise exit 3.\n- Balance: the resulting balance of the account (sum of its stored amounts plus the new amount) is checked with `balance_rules.check_final_balances`; a negative result exits 3.\n- The new `txn_id` is the largest stored id plus one, or 1 for an empty table, computed from `db.transactions.list`. The id computation, the balance check and the insert run in one database transaction so two concurrent posts never share an id.\n- A missing memo stores the empty string.\n- Success writes the header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and the new row, amount with exactly two decimals.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm the account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm the category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — read: list stored transactions for id and balance computation - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create the transaction - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-post-success ===\nIntent: A valid post stores the row with the next id and prints it; the stored row reads back with integer cents.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQPOST1\"\ncat = \"ZQPOSTC1\"\namount = \"45.50\"\ndate = \"2026-04-01\"\nmemo = \"walk in sale\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Post Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Post Category\")\n    ids = [r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()]\n    expected_id = max(ids) + 1 if ids else 1\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", acct, cat, amount, date, memo)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = date, acct, cat, amount, memo]\n    back = db.transactions.get(txn_id=expected_id)\n    assert back is not None\n    assert back.amount == int(Decimal(amount) * 100)\n    assert isinstance(back.amount, int)\n    assert (back.date, back.account, back.category, back.memo) == (date, acct, cat, memo)\n=== END AC txn-post-success ===\n\n=== AC txn-post-no-memo ===\nIntent: A post db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Amend Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=original, memo=\"\"\n    )\n    for amount in (\"0\", \"0.00\", \"-0\", \"1.234\", \".5\", \"+5.00\", \"abc\", \"1,000.00\"):\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", str(txn_id), amount)\n        assert code and memo are never altered.\n- No floating point is used for money at any layer.\n- A rejected amendment writes nothing; the balance check precedes the update.\n- A failing command writes nothing to stdout and never echoes a DSN or credential.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-TxnDelete.md ===\n# FEATURE: Txn Delete\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261026 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger txn delete <id>`, which removes a transaction only when no balance would go negative. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-TxnPost.md, FEATURE-BalanceRules.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-CliFoundation.md, FEATURE-ErrorContract.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides | ledger txn delete |\n| Consumes | ledger.register_command, persistence.open_database, balance_rules.check_final_balances, csv_output.write_rows, ledger_errors.NotFound, ledger_errors.Rejected |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nRemove one transaction by id. Deleting a receipt can push an account negative, so the balance rule is applied to the state after the deletion.\n\n## Behavior\n\n- Invocation: `ledger txn delete <id>` with exactly one argument.\n- A non-integer id exits 3. An integer id with no stored row exits 4.\n- The account's balance without this row is checked with `balance_rules.check_final_balances`; a negative result exits 3 and changes nothing.\n- Success deletes the row and writes two lines: `deleted`, then the id.\n- Read, check and delete run in one database transaction.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: get the transaction - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — read: list the account's transactions for the balance check - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — write: delete the transaction - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `txn_id`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC txn-delete-success ===\nIntent: Deleting a transaction prints deleted and the id and removes the row.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nacct = \"ZQDL1\"\ncat = \"ZQDLC1\"\ntxn_id = 940001\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.accounts.create(account=acct, name=\"Delete Account\")\n    db.categories.create(category=cat, description=\"Delete Category\")\n    db.transactions.create(\n        txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-1234, memo=\"\" \n    ) if False else None\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id + 1, date=\"2026-04-01\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=5000, memo=\"\")\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=txn_id, date=\"2026-04-02\", account=acct, category=cat, amount=-1234, memo=\"tape\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", str(txn_id))\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out))) == [[\"deleted\"], [str(txn_id)]]\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id) is None\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=txn_id + 1) is not None\n=== END AC
